text: * The three lines are developed as follows: 1. Total variable costs line is drawn between the origin and total variable costs at an arbitrary sales volume. At 3,000 units, total variable costs are $114,000 (3,000 x $38). 2. Total revenues line is drawn through the origin and a point representing total revenues at some arbitrary sales volume. At 3,000 units, Razor’'s hypothetical total revenues are $180,000 (3,000 x $60). 3. Total costs line is computed by layering fixed costs, $50,000 in this case, on top of total variable costs. This gives a vertical axis intercept of $50,000 and total costs of $164,000 at 3,000 units.
